Context: 17. Cash Handling Allowance to Cashiers

- (v) Only one official should be allowed the allowance in an Office / Department.
- (vi) The allowance is not admissible to UDC-cum-Cashiers as cash handling is part and parcel of the duties of this post.
- (vii) The rate will be increased by 25% every time the DA payable on revised pay scales goes up by 50%.  
The Allowance has been subsumed in Cash Handling and Treasury Allowance.
